notes.title: Major 2.0 Update!
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone that has taken the time to play The Cullfield Ritual, and a huge shoutout to those who have given me direct feedback about the game itself. Looking back, TCR launched in a bit of a broken state, not to mention the identity issues the game battled with.

All the feedback has been taken into account, and aside from the overhauled graphics and bugfixes, the gameplay has also been updated.

The main game's puzzles have been slightly streamlined to ensure that the game flows better, and additionally a 15 minute prologue has been added with more condensed horror as the buildup in the main game is quite lengthy and therefore not very content creator friendly.

I hope you enjoy this update as much as I did building it, and I'd love to hear any feedback you may have on the update. Feel free to ping me on the discord linked in game, or drop me a mail at thedollargamestore@gmail.com
